channel.title: The Times of Israel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Times of Israel (timesofisrael.com)

item.title: Epstein files source who alleged Mossad links is identified as Holocaust denier
item.description: Confidential tipster who told FBI that sex offender was tied to Israeli intelligence is a fraudster, but the allegations gained widespread traction online and in news reports The post Epstein files source who alleged Mossad links is identified as Holocaust denier appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump formally invited to attend Israel Prize ceremony in Jerusalem
item.description: White House has yet to respond to invitation for April event, though US president indicated he would attend when Israeli education minister announced he won the prize The post Trump formally invited to attend Israel Prize ceremony in Jerusalem appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Antisemitic incidents in UK, led by Manchester attack, remained near record highs in 2025 — report
item.description: Community Security Trust says last year saw second-highest ever number of incidents targeting Jews it has recorded, following dip in 2024 The post Antisemitic incidents in UK, led by Manchester attack, remained near record highs in 2025 — report appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: In Australia, Herzog says he hopes Netanyahu-Trump talks can undermine Iran’s ’empire of evil’
item.description: PM discusses Iran negotiations with Witkoff and Kushner, will hold sit-down with Rubio before meeting US president, who says Tehran would be ‘foolish’ not to make a deal on its nuclear and missile programs The post In Australia, Herzog says he hopes Netanyahu-Trump talks can undermine Iran’s ’empire of evil’ appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: New PBS series examines bittersweet ties that have historically bound US Blacks and Jews
item.description: For Black History Month, docuseries 'Black and Jewish America: An Interwoven History' parses what has unified and divided the communities, amid today's renewed tensions The post New PBS series examines bittersweet ties that have historically bound US Blacks and Jews appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Protesters hold nationwide ‘day of disruption’ over soaring violent crime in Arab community
item.description: Man killed in the Galilee as 4 protesters arrested at Haifa rally demanding police act against surging homicides; 7 others detained for pouring red dye in fountain, blocking traffic The post Protesters hold nationwide ‘day of disruption’ over soaring violent crime in Arab community appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Shin Bet removes Russian-born Israeli journalist from PM’s plane at last minute
item.description: Nick Kolyohin, a contributor for Chinese state news agency who once worked in PM's office and was set to cover Netanyahu-Trump meeting for Russian TV, says he was told his 'connections' needed to be verified The post Shin Bet removes Russian-born Israeli journalist from PM’s plane at last minute appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: US commerce chief Lutnick acknowledges ‘Epstein Island’ lunch but denies closer ties
item.description: White House says Trump still 'fully supports' his commerce secretary amid growing calls for him to resign over his links to Epstein The post US commerce chief Lutnick acknowledges ‘Epstein Island’ lunch but denies closer ties appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Ten dead, including shooter, in attack on school and residence in western Canada
item.description: Assailant targets secondary school in village of Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, wounding 27 in killing reminiscent of shootings in US; PM Carney cancels trip to Munich The post Ten dead, including shooter, in attack on school and residence in western Canada appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump told police chief in 2006 that ‘everyone’ knew about Epstein, FBI document says
item.description: Report of 2019 interview with Palm Beach police chief says now-president, who repeatedly claimed he knew nothing of Epstein's crimes, said 'thank goodness you're stopping him' The post Trump told police chief in 2006 that ‘everyone’ knew about Epstein, FBI document says appeared first on The Times of Israel.
